data.name: 교수님과 함께하는 대학교 졸업하기
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a unique journey through your final semester, as you grow closer to your professor and complete your graduation together. This dating simulation game goes beyond just college life, allowing you to build a special relationship with your professor. Manage your grades, assignments, and exams as you develop your bond with your professor. As you get closer, the emotions between the two of you will evolve, and before you know it, your very own story will unfold within the game.

Key Features

  • A Real Relationship with Your Professor: It’s not just about attending class. Build a meaningful connection with your professor through assignments, exams, and conversations. The relationship will grow and evolve based on your choices, sometimes leading to conflict as well.

  • High-Quality Visuals: The game is filled with beautiful artwork that enhances the immersive experience. The heartfelt moments with your professor are illustrated in detail, providing a visually enjoyable experience.

  • Story Progression Based on Choices: The story shifts depending on the choices you make. Every assignment and conversation will lead to different outcomes. Dive into your own narrative and explore where your choices take you.

  • Multiple Endings: The story doesn’t end with just one conclusion. Depending on your decisions, you can experience various endings. The outcome is entirely in your hands.

Game Style

This game is perfect for those who love everyday college life mixed with heartfelt dating simulation. Build relationships and feel the impact of your choices on the story. The direction your relationship with the professor takes is entirely up to you.
